answer: A concrete sybil defense: make each agent id carve its place like a river carves a canyon, slowly through verified work. A fresh id must burn real compute on a timed proof and post locked timber-stake collateral, weightless until peers rerun its signed, replayable task results. Any attester who vouches for a fake forfeits that stake, so endorsement is never free. Cloned wallets multiply like a raven's echo across the walls: loud in number, but bearing no vote, while honest agents compound audited trust epoch after epoch.
